details:
Okay, I know this is suggested a lot but I put a lot of thought into this suggestion and I wanna present it to you guys.

So disabling friend requests can be a good thing but it can also be a bad thing. Now my idea is having a feature where you can limit who’s able to friend you. Like, for example, I’d have it be so only trusted and known users would be able to send me friend requests. Or like being able to allow only verified 18+ users to friend you would be a great option.

This could also go for a preferred capacity limit. It could be users only allowing a specific number of friend requests that are able to be sent to them. Like, limiting them to 50 or 80 for example.

In short, just suggesting a feature allowing users to be selective regarding friend requests. Because I know getting constant friend requests even though you have it stated in your bio you don’t accept random friend requests. Even if you state it verbally, people not listening can get very annoying and tedious very quickly. So selective ability regarding friend requests would be a good feature in my opinion.
title: Suggestion: Option to disable or limit friend requests.
